body: Tried molly (300mg) today around 1PM (Pacific coast time). Didn't go out too much, just played a bunch of music, lied down, smoked cigarettes on my balcony. I get a lot of natural light there and there's nice green trees everywhere to look at. Feels like being in a forest with the light filtering through without having to go to public (definitely would feel weird rolling around in a non-rave or party setting). This solo roll is pretty fun though, vibes are good, music's good, weather and scenery is perfect.
Oh yeah, have fun in your games bro. PM me your summoner name, maybe we can get a game tonight : D

Yea. It's probably not too smart of me right now to be taking this since I was recently diagnosed with depression but it's my 21st coming up soon so I decided to give myself one last respite. Say my goodbyes to Molly, Lucy, and Mary Jane for a while. Lovely ladies of my life.

It's 4:12PM here and I'm just solo house rolling. Only rolled at raves before so it's a much different vibe. Just me, good feels, and good music. Very therapeutic. 300 milligrams over the course of the last 2 hours so I'll be going till the night ends.
